# Sales Handoff (Optional)

## Purpose
Turn completed kit into honest follow-up messaging that leads to managed execution.

## Package contract
Use from the `creator-breakout-kit` repo root. Paths are relative to that root.

## Inputs
- Final client brief summary
- strongest 2-3 concepts
- engagement context (cold reply / follow-up / call recap)

## Outputs
- short handoff email/DM
- one-line explanation of the kit
- follow-up CTA sequence

## Required language anchors
- creator angles most likely to break out before paying to source or produce
- built from breakout patterns, buyer psychology, and brand truth
- pattern fit over follower count
- strategy before sourcing, not an influencer list

## Forbidden claims
- creators already lined up
- creators ready to post
- guaranteed booked partners

## Quality bar
- message is clear, short, and believable
- CTA points to sourcing + briefing + management next step
